hero.summary: I'm a software developer focused on Python, Data Science, Machine Learning, Generative AI, and Agentic AI, with a background in enterprise application development and data processing.

paragraphs: I'm a software developer focused on Python, Data Science, Machine Learning, Generative AI, and Agentic AI, with a background in enterprise application development and data processing. My technical interests include transforming raw data into meaningful insights, developing machine learning solutions, and building intelligent applications powered by Large Language Models (LLMs).

My key areas of focus include Python Development, Data Science & Machine Learning, Generative AI (LangChain, embeddings, vector databases, RAG), Agentic AI (LangGraph, multi-agent orchestration, tool integration, memory, and Human-in-the-Loop approval mechanisms), and Backend Development (FastAPI).

I have worked on hands-on projects, including an Agentic AI Chatbot, Agentic Writer, and AI-powered travel planner. These projects have helped me explore agent orchestration, knowledge retrieval, workflow automation, and AI application architecture.
focusAreas: Agentic AI systems — RAG, tool-calling, MCP servers, multi-agent orchestration (LangGraph)

resumeSummary: Generative AI with nearly 2 years of production engineering experience at Accenture (Oct 2024 – Aug 2026), building agentic AI systems end-to-end alongside production Oracle PL/SQL work. Built and deployed Local Agent Pipeline — a fully local agentic system combining NL-to-SQL generation validated by a read-only SqlGuard, semantic search over 5,500+ transcript chunks via ChromaDB (RAG), an MCP server exposing tools for agent use, and a two-tier memory + SQLite cache, built with FastAPI and deployed via Docker on Render. Also shipped a full MERN-stack SaaS mock interview platform with JWT authentication and live LLM-based grading (Groq/Llama), an Oracle ETL data warehouse pipeline with production-style exception handling, a documented SQL performance tuning case study, and an n8n + LLM incident-triage automation — all version-controlled on GitHub, several with live public deployments on Render. Comfortable taking AI-backed systems from local development to publicly accessible, production deployments end-to-end. Java Full Stack Certified (Wipro TalentNext), AI/ML Virtual Internship Certified; eager to grow with a team building applied AI systems.

projects.title: Enterprise HR Policy Agentic RAG Copilot
projects.description: An end-to-end Agentic RAG copilot built with LangGraph, FastAPI, Pinecone, Groq API, and SQLite. Features smart routing, dynamic evidence grading (GOOD/WEAK classification), targeted Tavily web search fallbacks, and zero-hallucination guardrails.
projects.resumeDescription: Enterprise HR Policy Agentic RAG Copilot: LangGraph, FastAPI, Pinecone, Groq API, and SQLite with smart routing, dynamic evidence grading, targeted Tavily web search fallback, and zero-hallucination guardrails

projects.title: Local Agent Pipeline — NL-to-SQL + RAG + MCP
projects.description: A fully local agentic pipeline over NASA mission data: natural-language-to-SQL generation validated by a read-only SqlGuard, semantic search over 5,500+ transcript chunks via ChromaDB, an MCP server exposing it all as callable tools, and a two-tier (memory + SQLite) cache. Built with FastAPI, containerized with Docker, and deployed on Render.

projects.title: Job Search Agent — Multi-Agent LangGraph Pipeline
projects.description: A multi-agent job search system built on LangGraph: agents search across Remotive, Adzuna, and Apify-scraped LinkedIn/Naukri listings, an LLM ranking agent scores fit against the candidate's resume, and a deterministic ATS keyword-matching agent (mirroring how real applicant tracking systems screen resumes) filters and surfaces only the strongest matches. Includes on-demand resume tailoring toward a target ATS score with a truthfulness guardrail (never fabricates skills), live incremental result streaming, and a React dashboard.
projects.resumeDescription: Multi-agent job search pipeline (LangGraph): search agents across Remotive/Adzuna/Apify (LinkedIn, Naukri), an LLM fit-ranking agent, and a deterministic ATS keyword-matching agent mirroring real applicant tracking systems; on-demand ATS-targeted resume tailoring with a truthfulness guardrail, live streaming results, FastAPI + React, deployed on Render
